source_judgments: PPSR-001 is closed by exactly two JSON source-owner substitutions and one generated-view dependency line:15.5.2.10 owns actual arguments associated with dummy procedure entities;15.5.2.9 owns coarray dummies. No other source definition, pending plan or semantic restriction changes.

The complete original15.5.2.10 qualifications remain: explicit/implicit interfaces, procedure-characteristic exceptions, pointer/target and INTENT(IN) conditions, host-instance lifetime and the conditional explicit-interface-or-EXTERNAL rule. No unconditional target keyword rule is introduced.

R856 requires a nonempty pointer-declaration list. R857 distinguishes the data-object/deferred-shape route from the procedure-pointer route, including explicit R804/R822 versus assumed R402 name productions.
Omitting inline shape does not establish scalar rank when another declaration specifies shape. A procedure-name array suffix can involve C810 and is not automatically an isolated R857 negative.

C892 requires the actual EXTERNAL attribute. A qualifying ordinary specific interface or procedure declaration can supply it without the keyword; ABSTRACT INTERFACE alone is a template and a separate module interface is a different route.

The missing-EXTERNAL module-subroutine/interface contrast remains an unapproved source lead. Identity, ordering, role, C855 overlap, complete valid repair and causal report obligations remain unresolved.
Canonical C855 evidence is not automatically a standalone POINTER statement occurrence. No numbered-wrapper link, source-use approval, cloned case or duplicate execution is added.

PROTECTED retains module-specification scope, C857 categories, C858 COMMON exclusion, distinct C859 value and C860 association contexts, p2 exceptions and p3 subobject inheritance. Descendant definition access does not authorize a new submodule declaration.

PROTECTED is not PRIVATE, immutable pointed-at storage, synchronization, defined association status or extended target lifetime. Neither statement declaration supplies a runtime effect or authorizes reading an undefined pointer.
Both p1 paragraphs are canonical attribute routes, not invented S effects. The POINTER note is accounted without treating its incomplete excerpt as a complete executed program.
